title: Howden PRO E-Series | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Howden's PRO E-Series cooling tower fans are highly versatile, low-vibration and chemically resistant. Cooling Tower replacement parts by ICST.

layout.title: Howden PRO E-Series | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: The Howden E-Series cooling tower fans are a highly versatile that can perform in a wide range of cooling tower environments where stress on the fan may be a consideration. The E-Series is a low-vibration fan, chemically resistant with sustainability in harsh environments.

bullets.text: Damps mechanical vibration: the FRP blades offer vibration damping and good chemical resistance.
Lasts for many years the fan blade is integrated (rather than bolted on) to the shaft, so there’s not much mechanical stress at the joints
Simple to assemble – E-series fans come with clear technical documentation
Applications – Field-erected cooling towers, packaged cooling towers, air-cooled condensers (ACC) and air cooled heat exchangers (ACHE)
